new_text: Around 09:00 on June 12, 2026, the consolidated root cause of the MTP corruption investigation was concluded to be serving forward-pass numerical non-determinism from runtime/NPU compute kernels, ruling out weights, sampler, and MTP. Evidence: temp=0 same-input yields 5 different outputs; same-token prefill prompt_logprob spread of 6.42 nat in serial batch=1 indicates forward kernel non-determinism; P(lock|first≠5)=0 over 200 trials confirms necessary gateway; all2all, sampler, and MTP were ruled out. The remaining specific source is attention FIA fallback or in-kernel atomic reductions.
old_text: The root cause of garbage token generation in MTP mode is that bonus sampling (main sampler) and verify sampling share self.dsa_stream without proper synchronization, causing the bonus probability buffer to be contaminated by unsynchronized data.

note: consolidated root cause displaces early hypothesis
